parsed.notes: This document is a Review Article. It summarizes existing research, technologies, and materials in the field of haptics for VR/AR. The tables provided (Table 1 and Table 2) aggregate performance metrics (sensitivity, frequency, resolution, force, etc.) from various cited studies (References [1]-[201]). There are no original statistical analyses (such as ANOVA, t-tests, or regressions) performed on new data within this specific document. Therefore, no p-values or statistical causal claims are available to extract.
